html:
On 1 February 2021 the Burmese army seized power and arrested Aung San Suu Kyi and other leaders of the elected government. It claimed fraud in the 2020 election, which her party had won by a landslide.

Millions joined strikes and protests. When soldiers shot protesters, many young people took up arms in People's Defence Forces, joining ethnic armies such as those of the Karen.

The war spread across the country. By 2024 the army had lost large areas of the borderlands, while airstrikes killed thousands and millions fled their homes. It recalled Ne Win's coup of 1962 and the crackdown of 1988.
sum: On 1 February 2021 the Burmese army seized power and arrested Aung San Suu Kyi and other leaders of the elected government. It claimed fraud in the 2020 election, which her party had won by a landslide.
